hypothesis: In a coupled-cell bioelectric model of the anterior stage-15 Xenopus neurula built with the paper's stated ingredients (Table 1 concentrations, 0.1x MMR medium, three regions whose K+/Cl- leak differences give a hyperpolarized neural tube near -50 mV and lateral neural folds/ectoderm near -5 mV, Kir channels, voltage-sensitive gap junctions) and BETSE's HCN2 kinetic model (V1/2 = -99 mV shifted +20 mV by cAMP, Na+:K+ permeability 0.2), adding homogeneously expressed HCN2 opens it preferentially in the hyperpolarized tube, drives tube cells further negative, and leaves the depolarized lateral regions essentially unchanged, i.e. it amplifies the existing Vmem gradient rather than shifting all regions uniformly.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered, evaluated at the primary HCN2 expression level (the paper's/BETSE's stated HCN2 maximum permeability if recoverable from Table 1, the Supplementary Note or a published BETSE config; otherwise the BETSE default for its HCN2 channel class) in the three-region coupled sheet calibrated so the HCN2-free control gives tube Vmem within -50 +/- 10 mV and lateral Vmem within -5 +/- 5 mV: ALL of (a) the GHK reversal potential of HCN2 current under Table 1 cytosol and 0.1x MMR is more negative than the control tube Vmem; (b) tube Vmem with HCN2 minus control tube Vmem <= -15 mV; (c) the largest absolute change in mean Vmem of either lateral region <= 5 mV; (d) the lateral-minus-tube Vmem difference increases by >= 15 mV; (e) steady-state HCN2 open probability in the tube is >= 5 times that in the ectoderm. Secondary (switch/amplification): in uncoupled single cells whose control Vmem is swept from about -70 to 0 mV by varying K+ leak, the HCN2-induced shift is >= 15 mV in magnitude for some cells with control Vmem <= -40 mV and <= 5 mV for all cells with control Vmem >= -15 mV, and the expression range (log sweep 0.01x to 100x the primary level) over which (b)-(d) all hold spans at least one decade.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: any of (i) HCN2 reversal potential more positive than the control tube Vmem (opening would depolarize the tube); (ii) tube shift > -5 mV at the primary expression level (no amplification); (iii) lateral shift magnitude >= half the tube shift magnitude at the primary level (near-uniform shift, not switch-like); (iv) no expression level in the 0.01x-100x sweep satisfies (b)-(d). Outcomes meeting neither the pass nor the fail criterion are pre-registered as 'mixed'. If the control calibration (tube -50 +/- 10, lateral -5 +/- 5 mV) cannot be achieved with Table 1 concentrations and the stated channel set, verdict is 'inconclusive' with reason 'other'.
planned_datasets: betse-source (https://github.com/betsee/betse, BSD-2-Clause): HCN2 kinetic model (betse/science/channels/vg_funny.py), Kir model, gap-junction voltage-sensitivity parameters and defaults from betse/data/yaml/sim_config.yaml
pai2018-fulltext (Europe PMC full-text XML for PMC5843655): Table 1 initial concentrations and stated model parameters
pai2018-supplementary (Europe PMC supplementary files for PMC5843655, if retrievable): Supplementary Note regional leak permeabilities and HCN2 expression level

preregistration_amendments.text: Model specification fixed after reading Supplementary Note 1 and Fig. 2a of the paper (parameters only; no simulation run yet). (1) HCN2 exactly as Supplementary Note 1: m_inf = 1/(1+exp((V+79)/6.2)) (BETSE HCN2 V1/2 = -99 mV shifted +20 mV), P_K = Pmax*m, P_Na = 0.2 P_K, P_Ca = 0.05 P_K; Pmax = 6.7e-10 m/s for wild type, 6.7e-8 m/s for overexpression. The primary comparison is therefore the paper's: control WITH wild-type HCN2 (6.7e-10) versus HCN2-overexpressing (6.7e-8); the HCN2-free control named in the original pass criterion is also reported and the verdict must agree for both baselines or the outcome is 'mixed'. The expression sweep is 0.01x-100x of 6.7e-8. (2) Kir as Supplementary Note 1 (Pmax 3.33e-9 m/s, Mg block, [Mg] 0.5 mM, K0 0.025 mM, z_eff 1.5), homogeneous. (3) Leak permeabilities Na:K:Cl = 1:1:2 in the neural tube and 1:1:15 in neural folds and ectoderm (Fig. 2a); the absolute scale P0 is not stated and is the single calibration parameter, chosen on a log grid 1e-11..1e-7 m/s to minimise (Vtube+50)^2+(Vlateral+5)^2 for the wild-type-HCN2 control. (4) Transmembrane GHK fluxes use Table 1 cytosol versus 0.1x MMR (the medium the paper says cells face; Supplementary Figs. 5-7 compute channel I-V curves this way); concentrations held fixed (no pump, no concentration dynamics). A sensitivity run with Table 1 intercellular (extracellular-space) concentrations instead is reported but does not set the verdict. T = 310 K, Cm = 0.05 F/m2. (5) Gap junctions: BETSE electrodiffusive GJ (D = Do_ion * gj_surface * gjopen over gj length 26 nm, Harris-1983 gating with BETSE constants, threshold 15 mV, gj_min 0.1), on a hexagonal sheet approximating Fig. 2a (circular ectoderm, teardrop neural folds, a ~4-cell-wide midline tube). The paper does not state its GJ strength; gj_surface is swept over {5e-8 (BETSE default), 1e-8, 5e-9, 1e-9, 5e-10, 1e-10, 1e-11, 0}. Primary = BETSE default if the control calibrates (tube -50+/-10, lateral -5+/-5 mV); otherwise the most strongly coupled gj_surface at which it calibrates. Verdict criteria are applied at the primary; agreement across all calibrated gj_surface values is reported. Steady state is reached by implicit (pseudo-transient) time stepping from Vmem = 0, as in BETSE's initial condition.

test_contract.expected_observation: With homogeneous HCN2 added to the calibrated three-region model, steady-state tube Vmem moves at least 15 mV more negative while both lateral regions move by at most 5 mV, and HCN2 open probability is much higher in the tube than in the ectoderm; across uncoupled cells the HCN2-induced shift is large for already-hyperpolarized cells and negligible for depolarized cells.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: HCN2 reversal potential above the tube Vmem (opening depolarizes), a tube shift smaller than 5 mV, a lateral shift at least half the tube shift (uniform rather than gradient-selective effect), or no HCN2 expression level in a four-decade sweep producing the selective amplification.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: The simulator's own published HCN2, Kir and gap-junction model code and defaults (BETSE, the engine the paper used) and the paper's own stated parameters (Table 1, Supplementary Note, main text). The claim is about the paper's model, so the source paper's parameters are admissible; no fitting to the paper's Fig. 3 outcomes beyond the pre-registered control calibration targets stated in the text (-50 mV tube, -5 mV lateral).
test_contract.inference_method: Deterministic simulation: integrate C dV/dt = -(sum of GHK ionic currents + gap-junction currents) to steady state for each cell, with and without HCN2, and compare regional mean Vmem against the fixed thresholds above; single-cell and expression-level sweeps test the switch/amplification character. No statistical test; thresholds are absolute mV differences.
